contract.task_clause:
A CPA prepares income tax returns for a client. After the client signs and mails the returns, the CPA discovers an error. According to Treasury Circular 230, the CPA must
Option A: Document the error in the workpapers.
Option B: Prepare an amended return within 30 days of the discovery of the error.
Option C: Promptly advise the client of the error.
Option D: Promptly resign from the engagement and cooperate with the successor accountant.
